title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Tier Priced on a New-Room Span
content:
**Tier pricing note, new rooms — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The priced tier of the new-room span — the tier whose daily rate prices the days in the new room — follows the agreement.

- Where the agreement carries an isolation placement, it is the agreement's isolation billing tier.
- Where it carries none and the agreement's tier is not the tier of the charge the span is split from, it is the agreement's tier.
- Otherwise it is the tier of the charge the span is split from.

| Agreement's tier | Its isolation billing tier |
|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |

**Points of judgement.** A resident who asked to move and whose agreement now records the new tier, no isolation placement: the agreement's tier. A center-directed infection-control move recorded with an isolation placement: the isolation billing tier of the agreement's tier, whatever room the resident occupies.
